origin: ngspice code-model netlists written for M17 (decision 0020), and variants of them, each changing one form
author: xdylanm
notes: The base netlists were written here and run in ngspice 47; the ngspice distribution's examples are not copied. Provenance confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-11-10.

test_xspice_control.cir.note: %vnam, a %i(...) output, and limit with fraction=FALSE (base netlist, written for M17).

test_xspice_digital.cir.note: adc_bridge and dac_bridge with vector ports, d_inverter, d_nand with ~, and d_dff with null set and reset (base netlist, written for M17).

test_xspice_digital_subckt.cir.note: test_xspice_digital.cir inside a subcircuit, with NULL and Null (variant).

test_xspice_filesource.cir.note: filesource with a quoted file= path, its data file beside it (variant).

test_xspice_filesource.txt.note: The data file test_xspice_filesource.cir reads: time and value columns (written for M17).

test_xspice_gain.cir.note: gain with no port types, %v(...) and %vd(... ...) (base netlist, written for M17).

test_xspice_gain_blank_types.cir.note: test_xspice_gain.cir with each port type before a blank: %v in, %v (in), %vd in mid, %vd (in mid) (variant).

test_xspice_summer.cir.note: summer with a vector port, a typed vector port holding a %vd connection, and vector parameters with a brace, over a + line (base netlist, written for M17).

test_xspice_summer_dvector.cir.note: test_xspice_summer.cir with a differential vector port, %vd [in1 0 in2 0], and %v [in1 %vd in2 in1] (variant; manual §8.1.1 Examples 1 and 2).

test_xspice_summer_unbracketed.cir.note: test_xspice_summer.cir with .model values written without parentheses, blanks inside the brackets and a vector over a + line (variant).
